title: Stracciatella Soup
description: This stracciatella soup is Chef John's Italian-inspired, broth-based recipe with cheese and egg whisked in — ready to serve in less than 30 minutes.
ingredients: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring broth to a simmer in a pot over high heat. Taste broth and adjust salt and pepper as needed.
Whisk eggs, grated Parmigiano Reggiano and Pecorino Romano cheeses, parsley, semolina flour, salt, pepper, cayenne, and nutmeg together in a bowl until well blended.
While stirring the simmering broth, slowly pour egg mixture into the broth. Bring mixture back up to a simmer. The liquid will be slightly cloudy initially and clear as broth heats.
Serve in bowls; garnish with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of red pepper flakes.

video.description: When the day is long, the kitchen’s bare and you’re feeling weary, this is the soup to lift your spirits and get you back on track. Combining a simmering seasoned broth with raggedy quick “egg drops,” you’ll get the satisfaction you require. Whole eggs, semolina and some Romano and parmesan cheeses add just the right amount of flavor and body and comfort. Combine with a salad and some crusty bread and you’ll no longer need to worry about dinner.
